summary:
## 1. Customer Profile
The customer is Sambo Shimanski, a male, whose age is not mentioned in the transcript. He is a parent with a three-year-old child, who is of Chinese origin, and whose family has been living in Finland for a while, as the child was born in Finland. The customer's language skills are not explicitly mentioned, but it is clear that he is not fluent in Finnish, as he asks for clarification on various terms and concepts. He has a tourist visa, but his child has a permanent residence in Finland.

## 2. Reason for Visit
The customer came to the service today because he is looking for a place for his three-year-old child to attend kindergarten or daycare. He has been searching for a suitable option for two weeks and is getting worried. He is currently working in Finland, but his child has been staying at home without any care.

## 3. Topics Discussed
The customer asked about the Finnish child care system, specifically about the different types of kindergartens and daycare centers available. He was unsure about the eligibility criteria and the application process for municipal and private daycare centers. He also inquired about the language support available for children who do not speak Finnish. Additionally, he discussed the importance of learning English, mathematics, and playing the piano with his child.

## 4. Guidance and Information Provided
The customer was provided with information about the different types of early childhood education services available in Espoo, including municipal and private daycare centers, family daycare, and open playgrounds. He was advised to prioritize the location, cost (free of charge), and language support when searching for a suitable option. The customer was also shown the ESPO early education website, which provides detailed information about the application process, eligibility criteria, and guidelines for selecting a daycare center. The customer was informed that his child can get part-time care in Finland, either in public or private daycare, but that he needs to have a residence or permanent address in Finland to be eligible for municipal services.

## 5. Referrals and Next Steps
The customer was referred to the ESPO early education website, where he can find detailed information about the application process and eligibility criteria for municipal and private daycare centers. He was advised to discuss his options with the daycare service and to submit an application in paper form if he does not have an online banking code or a Finnish personal identity code for his child. The customer was also told that he can only submit one application per child at a time and that he should contact the early childhood education service for further guidance.

## 6. Additional Observations
The customer seemed to be getting anxious about finding a suitable daycare option for his child, which was evident in his tone and language. He had some difficulty understanding Finnish terminology and concepts, which required the customer service officer to explain and clarify the information. The customer's communication style was friendly and cooperative, and he was appreciative of the guidance and information provided.

extraction.Referrals_Made: The ESPO early education website, and the possibility of discussing with the kindergarten or daycare service.
extraction.Confidence_Notes: All fields extracted with reasonable confidence.
